hero.tag: Production ownership for systems that move money and data at speed.
hero.intro: I design, build, and own backend platforms for fintech and real-time products where throughput, correctness, and uptime matter. My work spans trading and custody systems, high-volume telemetry pipelines, distributed service architecture, and production operations from greenfield delivery to scale-up.

about.heading: Building systems that hold under pressure
about.body1: My work is centered on backend systems that operate under real pressure — fintech APIs, trading and custody workflows, distributed services processing real-time events, and telemetry pipelines where throughput and correctness both matter.
about.body2: I own the full lifecycle: system design, implementation, infrastructure, observability, and production operations. I work in .NET, Go, Node.js, Rust, and Python, and I understand the tradeoffs that matter when building distributed systems in regulated, latency-sensitive environments.
about.body3: When the product demands it, I also deliver full-stack. But my strongest contribution is always at the system and backend layer — designing for reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

work.heading: Case Studies
work.subheading: A selection of systems I've designed, built, and operated in production.

projects.title: Self-Service Trading Platform
projects.problem: A fintech operator needed a production-ready self-service platform for live trading operations, MT5 integration, multi-provider payments, KYC compliance, and reliable customer/account provisioning.
projects.built: Designed and implemented backend services for trading operations, MetaTrader 5 flows, payment provider integrations, KYC orchestration, and real-time account state. Built event-driven workflows with RabbitMQ, Redis-backed hot state, Socket.IO streams, and production deployment on Docker/Kubernetes.
highlights: MT5 integration with order lifecycle management
Multi-provider payment routing with reconciliation
KYC flow orchestration with audit trail
Real-time account and position streaming via WebSocket
Containerised deployment with Docker and Kubernetes
Production patterns across Kafka-ready messaging, CQRS/Event Sourcing, and GraphQL-facing services
projects.impact: Moved a complex fintech operations surface into production with clear ownership of reliability, auditability, and scale readiness across trading, payment, and KYC workflows.

projects.title: Real-Time Telemetry & Fleet Tracking Backend
projects.problem: A fleet management product needed to ingest Teltonika GPS telemetry at higher volume, process live location and route data, and serve multiple client applications without the Node.js pipeline becoming the throughput ceiling.
projects.built: Designed the telemetry ingestion pipeline including binary protocol parsing, geolocation processing, and route generation logic. Migrated critical ingestion paths from Node.js to Go and connected distributed services with RabbitMQ, gRPC, Redis, and MongoDB.
highlights: Binary Teltonika protocol parser
High-throughput telemetry ingestion pipeline
Real-time geolocation and route computation
gRPC-based inter-service communication
Redis-backed hot state for active vehicle tracking
projects.impact: Increased telemetry handling capacity from roughly 80 to roughly 800 records/sec, a 10x throughput improvement, while keeping live vehicle updates responsive for enterprise fleet customers.

projects.title: Payment & KYC Integration Layer
projects.problem: Financial products need reliable, auditable integrations for identity checks, customer provisioning, account creation, deposits, withdrawals, balances, statements, and B2B flows. Failures in these paths carry direct financial and compliance risk.
projects.built: Built modular payment and KYC integration services with provider abstraction, idempotent transaction handling, event-sourced audit trails, and compliance state machines. Supported Django multi-tenant KYC and account/customer provisioning patterns for exchange and custody workflows.
highlights: Provider-agnostic payment abstraction layer
Idempotent transaction processing
Webhook ingestion with at-least-once delivery guarantees
KYC state machine with document lifecycle management
Full audit log for regulatory traceability
projects.impact: Reduced integration risk by isolating provider complexity behind auditable backend flows and enabling expansion across exchange, custody, and B2B financial operations.

projects.title: Serverless API Platform
projects.problem: A product team needed a cost-efficient, low-operational-overhead backend API that could scale automatically and integrate tightly with AWS managed services.
projects.built: Contributed to a serverless backend using AWS Lambda with API Gateway, DynamoDB for primary storage, and event-driven architecture for async processing. Focused on function design, cold start optimization, and service integration patterns.
highlights: Lambda function design with cold-start mitigation
DynamoDB access patterns and single-table design
API Gateway integration with request validation
Event-driven async processing
Infrastructure-as-code deployment
projects.impact: Delivered customer-facing API capabilities with lower operational overhead than managed VM deployments and a scaling model aligned to variable production traffic.
